description: Where to get StoryShort on each platform: the App Store listing for iPhone and iPad, the Mac App Store listing, the web app (any browser, Android included), the Android APK (direct download) and the Android closed beta, plus the URL of a QR code image for the App Store page. Also lists what does not exist yet (a public Google Play listing) so nobody is sent to a link that is not there. For a user who asks how to install, download or open StoryShort. Needs no credentials and no scope. Read-only and free: nothing is created or charged.

platform.description: Optional. Return only this platform: ios (iPhone and iPad), macos, web or android. Omit for all of them.
